tapin.topic: Topuria vs Gaethje title fight breakdown
key_facts: Ilia Topuria defends the featherweight title against Justin Gaethje at UFC 350 on August 15
Topuria is undefeated at 16-0 with 14 finishes
Gaethje earned the shot by knocking out Dan Hooker in round two in May
The fight headlines the card at the T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas

tapin.topic: Marvel Rivals season 3 balance patch shakes up the meta
key_facts: The season 3 patch reduced Iron Man's unibeam damage by 15 percent
Cyclops joined the roster as a duelist on July 1
Win rates for Storm rose from 48 to 53 percent after her movement buff
Ranked mode now bans two heroes per team per match

moneywise.topic: What the Fed's rate cut means for your savings account
key_facts: The Federal Reserve cut its benchmark rate by 25 basis points to a 4.00-4.25 percent target range
High-yield savings accounts averaged 4.1 percent APY before the cut
Analysts expect two more cuts before year end
Savings yields typically fall within weeks of a Fed cut
